headline: EmbeddingGemma 2 brings semantic retrieval onto the device

source.title: Bring multimodal semantic search to the edge with EmbeddingGemma 2

summary: Google introduced EmbeddingGemma 2 for compact multimodal embedding workloads on edge devices.
why_it_matters: The release gives engineers another option for building responsive semantic-search experiences close to where data is created.
related_coverage: The companion infrastructure story examines a different part of the latency stack.
image_alt_intent: Comparison diagram showing remote and on-device semantic search architectures.
